page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Top: the centred heading "ERRATA." Below it an italic address to the reader, set as a single paragraph. Then the centred heading "ARABICA." and a list of Arabic errata entries, one line per entry in Arabic and Latin, running down the column. Below the list, the heading "LATINA." at the right. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.
page.head: ERRATA.

p.i: Benevole Lector, ne quid in Arabico textu, aut ipsa versione te remorari posset, errata, quae Historiam mihi percurrenti obvia facta sunt, corrigenda esse duxi: teque commonendum, verba quaedam sine punctis orthographicis relicta fuisse, prout in autographo erant; perpauca etiam ambigua & incerta lectionis non versa: uti tuo de illis omnibus judicio & arbitrio utereris.

page.notes: The Arabic entries are copied as far as legible; the printed errata are dense and small, so individual diacritics and some numerals may be misread. The Latin words in the address are italic. The printed page number is absent. A few small marks and the scan's edge are not transcribed.
